{{Infobox Item |name = Keris partisan |image = [[File:Keris partisan.png]] |release = [[27 April]] [[2022]] |update = Beneath Cursed Sands |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = No |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Wield, Drop |examine = A mystical-feeling polearm. |value = 60000 |alchable = No |weight = 2.267 |id = 25979 |leagueRegion = Desert }} [[File:Keris partisan detail.png|left|150px]] The '''keris partisan''' is a one-handed [[partisan]] requiring 65 [[Attack]] to wield. It is obtained from [[Maisa]] as a reward for completing [[Beneath Cursed Sands]]. Players may own multiple partisans; additional partisans may be purchased from [[Selim]] in [[Al Kharid]] for 60,000 [[coins]] each. [[weapon poison (disambiguation)|Weapon poisons]] cannot be applied to the partisan. The keris partisan retains the effects of the [[keris]], dealing 33%{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1587016970926538753|date=31 October 2022|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/27963838|archivedate=4 August 2023|quote=[Is the keris partisan bonus damage against Kalphites/Scabarites 33% or 4/3?] 33%.}} bonus damage against all [[Kalphite_(attribute)|kalphites and scabarites]], alongside a 1/51 chance of puncturing a hole in their exoskeleton, dealing triple damage. When this special effect occurs, the chatbox will display the message: {{mes|You slip your weapon through a gap in the creature's chitin, landing a vicious blow.}} Unlike the [[keris]], however, the partisan provides a secondary crush bonus. Players can attach one of four jewels, which are obtained as rewards from the [[Tombs of Amascut]], to the keris partisan. Doing so increases the requirement to wield them to 80 [[Attack]], and gives it differing effects within the raid. * The [[Breach of the Scarab]] creates the [[keris partisan of breaching]], granting an additional 33% accuracy against all Kalphites and Scabarites (effect persists outside the raid). * The [[Eye of the Corruptor]] creates the [[keris partisan of corruption]], granting a special attack that increases DPS. * The [[Jewel of Amascut]] creates the [[keris partisan of amascut]], decreasing damage bonus against Kalphites and Scabarites but enhancing base stats. * The [[Jewel of the Sun]] creates the [[keris partisan of the sun]], granting two passive effects and a special attack. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = +58 |aslash = -2 |acrush = +57 |amagic = +2 |arange = 0
